metadata.title: Agent Mesh: Governed Decentralized Coordination Under Partial Information

additional_titles.title: Architecture, Control Boundaries, and Lessons from an Inconclusive Preregistered Study

metadata.description: Agent Mesh is a provider-neutral coordination substrate for independently executing agents operating with bounded local state and partial information. This paper specifies its reference composition with evidence provenance, distributed planning, adaptive organization, partition and topology policy, approval checkpoints, local inference control, mission continuity, compromise response, heterogeneous adapters, and effect-time enforcement. Version 1.1 documents the receipt-producing governed runtime and its fail-before-start reference-integrated profile at source commit 230a6c52. The contribution is the explicit cross-layer contract separating information, agreement, assignment authority, and authorization of protected external effects. The manuscript also reports Campaign V28 as an inconclusive preregistered evaluation bound to the earlier commit f0412840; later source improvements are not treated as retrospective experimental evidence.
